question: Switzerland massively expanded one defence line. Where did it run?
answer: Not at the border: Switzerland massively expanded an older line set back from its borders, high in the mountains, the National Redoubt. Standing higher than the enemy is an advantage. The aim was not to beat an attacker but to make an attack not worth its price.
move: You don't have to beat an attacker, only make the attack not worth its price.

web.label: A map of Switzerland asks where its defence line ran. The reader draws the line on the map with a finger, then rates how sure they are of the answer.
